central_library.name: S. B. Jain Central Library
central_library.description: A fully computerized, state-of-the-art knowledge repository featuring open access, spacious general and individual reading halls, rare reference books, e-books, CD/DVD multimedia resources, national and international print journals, and e-journals from renowned publishers.
automation_and_features: Automated with advanced Library Management Software and Laser Bar-code Scanners for instant issue/return.
Web OPAC (Online Public Access Catalog) enabling students and faculty to search cataloged holdings from anywhere on the campus network.
SMS alert facility for book due dates and re-issue notifications.
Comprehensive Book Bank Facility providing a complete set of semester textbooks to all enrolled students.
NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning) video streaming local server giving direct access to IIT and IISc video lectures.
Digital Library with access to J-Gate, Map My Access, e-journals, and DELNET resources.

transportation.name: College Bus Transportation Fleet
transportation.details: SBJITMR operates a dedicated fleet of 20 college buses connecting all key localities across Nagpur city, Kamptee, and Saoner, ensuring safe, punctual transit for students and faculty.
transportation.timings: Arrives at campus by 10:00 AM; departs from campus at 5:30 PM.
transportation.safety_and_compliance: All 20 buses possess valid RTO Fitness, Permits, Insurance, PUC, and Tax certificates. Buses are fitted with RTO-compliant Electronic Speed Governors, GPRS vehicle tracking systems, First Aid kits, Fire Extinguishers, and designated Emergency Exit Doors.
transportation.public_transit_connectivity: Regular MSRTC (State Transport) buses also frequently ply on the Kalmeshwar Road directly stopping near the college campus.
transportation.emergency_vehicle: A dedicated emergency vehicle is stationed on campus 24 hours a day to handle any urgent medical or situational contingencies.

laboratories_and_workshops.overview: Each department possesses well-equipped, modern laboratories adhering to AICTE norms, including GPU-enabled AI labs, VLSI design tools, CNC machines, electrical drives, and advanced material testing equipment.

it_infrastructure_and_wifi.overview: High-speed campus-wide fiber optic backbone, high-bandwidth leased lines, Wi-Fi connectivity across academic blocks, smart classrooms equipped with multimedia projectors, and modern client-server network architecture.

sports_and_gymnasium.gymnasium: Modern campus gymnasium equipped with weight-training stations, treadmills, and fitness equipment.
sports_and_gymnasium.outdoor_sports: Full-sized playground for Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, and Kabaddi.
sports_and_gymnasium.indoor_sports: Facilities for Table Tennis, Badminton, Chess, and Carrom.

power_backup.details: 100% heavy-duty silent diesel generator (DG) power backup ensures uninterrupted operation of computer laboratories, server rooms, smart classrooms, and library lighting during utility power outages.

counselling_facility.details: A designated Counselling Cell provides confidential psychological counseling, emotional well-being mentorship, and stress management support to students.

canteen_and_cafeteria.details: Spacious, hygienic cafeteria serving wholesome vegetarian meals, hot snacks, tea, coffee, and refreshments prepared under strict sanitary standards.

hostels_and_accommodation.details: The institute assists outstation students in securing comfortable, secure boys' and girls' hostel accommodations with verified private partners situated conveniently in nearby residential areas with bus pickup connectivity.
